title: India's foreign trade: composition, direction, deficit
quote: Services surplus vs structural merchandise deficit: Ricardian comparative advantage in services

boxes.title: Terms of trade & exchange rate
items: **NTT** = export price index / import price index x **100**
**GTT** = import qty / export qty; **ITT** = NTT x export qty index
Devaluation: exports cheaper abroad, imports dearer
**J-curve**: balance first worsens, then improves
==**Marshall-Lerner**: elasticities sum **greater than 1**==

boxes.title: Partners & balances
items: **Surplus** with **USA**, Netherlands; **deficit** with China, Russia, UAE, Saudi Arabia
==**China** = largest trading partner **FY 2025-26**== (trade **$151.1 bn**), overtaking USA
From China: APIs, solar PV cells, chips; to China: iron ore, cotton
BRICS trade **$203.1 bn (FY21) → $417.5 bn (FY26)**; deficit **$226.1 bn**
Electronics exports **$38.56 bn**; **smartphones 62.5%**

items.what: Merchandise deficit **$283.5 bn**; exports **$437.70 bn**, imports **$721.20 bn**

boxes.title: Causes of the deficit
steps: Import liberalisation: capital goods, APIs, electronics

boxes.title: World share, SEZ & policy
items: Merchandise: **18th** exporter (**1.8%**); services: ==**8th** (**4.3%**, WTO)== (⚠ ES: 7th)
First EPZ **Kandla 1965**; SEZ policy **April 2000**; **SEZ Act 2005**
**FTP 2023**: from **1 April 2023**, no end date; ==**$2 trillion** exports by **2030**==
**RoDTEP** replaced **MEIS**; rupee trade via **Special Rupee Vostro Accounts**
**APEDA** = agri exports, AEZs; **MPEDA** = marine; **14 FTAs**, 6 PTAs

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Largest import item = ==**POL / crude**== (PYQ 2018)
Trap: "lacklustre services" ==NOT a deficit factor== (PYQ 2017)
Import quota = **quantitative** restriction; intra-industry = same product
SEZ PYQ key: **EXIM Policy 2000-01**; first Agri Export Facilitation Centre **Pune, May 2021**
FTP target services share **4.2% by 2022** (PYQ 2019)
